package.name: tb3_bringup
package.description:
Bringup for the TurtleBot3 semantic navigation course: every launch file, the RViz config, the Gazebo worlds and the vendored Gazebo models live here. Nothing in this package runs code of its own — it only starts nodes that live in the tb3_* packages and points them at the right assets.
Start here when you are looking for "which file do I edit": launch/README.md maps each launch file to its terminal and to the config it reads.
